name: Arya R Nair
now: Wardrobe Randomizer + Networking, a digital wardrobe sharing platform in Java
bio: Second-year B.Tech CSE student at T.K.M. College of Engineering, Kollam, interested in frontend development, data science and AI. I like turning everyday problems into working web projects, and I'm currently building a digital wardrobe sharing platform in Java.

projects.title: Wardrobe Randomizer + Networking
projects.desc: A web platform where users digitize their wardrobe, get auto-generated outfit combinations, and borrow items from nearby people instead of buying new ones. The backend is written in Java with a native HTTP server and a SQLite database.
features: Digital wardrobe: upload clothes and accessories to build a personal catalog
Outfit randomizer across 5 slots (top, bottom, outerwear, footwear, accessory) with seasonal filters
Peer-to-peer lending with no money exchanged, for in-person nearby exchanges
AI image verification that compares an item's condition before lending and after return to detect damage
Trust rating system that updates from verified returns
Complaint and compensation module that calculates reimbursement from damage severity
Thrift store add-on for buying and selling small items and accessories
Planned: AI product suggestions with affiliate links (Amazon, Myntra)
projects.status: Pilot with a group of 4 people; courier-based expansion planned
